name: Consider It Marketed
tagline: Acts as a clinic's marketing department so the doctor can stay in the exam room.
description: Runs the promotion side of a small medical practice as a team of its own: campaigns get planned, search ads get bought, and creative and video go through a quality check before anything ships. The aim is to keep the physician who owns the practice out of the advertising console and with the people waiting to be seen.
author: CindyH874325640
